name: Proposals
description: Agent-proposed develop/watch/drop verdicts per candidate, reviewed in the decision queue

agentPrompts.label: Approve, request changes, or block a proposal
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-picks` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then record my decision on the proposal I name — approve, request changes, or block — with a review note. Do not perform the sourcing-brief export or busa-listing handoff yourself; that only happens after `execute_decisions.mjs` and my explicit confirmation.

agentPrompts.label: Edit a proposal's sourcing or listing brief
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-picks` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then update the drafted sourcing/listing brief text on the proposal I name with the changes I describe.

agentPrompts.label: What's waiting for my review?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-picks` skill in this folder, then list the proposals in `needs_review` or `changes_requested` status, with their verdict and reason, so I can work through the queue.
